Onboards one Cisco Intersight Blade or Rack server with five atomics: prove the target identity, derive and assign a same-organization Server Profile, submit ordered Deploy then Activate actions with reboot authorization, wait up to thirty minutes for exact healthy association with no queued or running work, then start vMedia OS installation. OS content is resolved only by exact identity, concrete type, and organization permission; Intersight decides repository readiness, metadata compatibility, model support, and content combinations. This version sends no Answers or AdditionalParameters. Profile derivation returns 409 instead of reusing an existing name and waits up to five minutes. OS waiting is optional and limited to three minutes; otherwise success means accepted, not completed. A bounded timeout becomes parent 202 only when the atomic proves acceptance with pending evidence. Import the five atomics before this workflow and select an authorized intersight.endpoint target.
Stops before any external call unless the operator explicitly confirms the complete target, profile, and OS selection.
Requires Confirm Server Onboarding to be true.
Populates all four standard outputs before stopping.

properties.description: Parses each retained atomic result and returns one structured terminal record without changing atomic decisions.
properties.script:
import json
import sys

def load(raw, label):
    try:
        value = json.loads(raw)
    except Exception as exc:
        raise ValueError(label + " is not valid JSON: " + str(exc))
    if not isinstance(value, dict):
        raise ValueError(label + " must be a JSON object.")
    return value

aggregationReady = False
aggregationStatusCode = "500"
aggregationStatusMessage = "Onboarding stage aggregation did not complete."
aggregationMessage = aggregationStatusMessage
aggregationResultJson = json.dumps({"error": aggregationMessage}, separators=(",", ":"))
try:
    serverIdentity = load(sys.argv[1], "Server Identity Result")
    derivation = load(sys.argv[2], "Profile Derivation Result")
    assignment = load(sys.argv[3], "Profile Assignment Result")
    deployment = load(sys.argv[4], "Profile Deployment Result")
    osInstallation = load(sys.argv[5], "OS Installation Result")
    completed = osInstallation.get("completed") is True
    accepted = osInstallation.get("requestAccepted") is True
    if not completed and not accepted:
        raise ValueError("OS Installation Result proves neither request acceptance nor completion.")
    onboardingCompleted = completed
    finalStage = "os-installation-completed" if completed else "os-installation-started"
    aggregationStatusCode = "200" if completed else "202"
    aggregationStatusMessage = "Server onboarding completed, including OS installation." if completed else "Server profile is associated and OS installation was accepted."
    aggregationMessage = aggregationStatusMessage
    aggregationResultJson = json.dumps({"orchestrationCompleted": True, "onboardingCompleted": onboardingCompleted, "profileOrigin": "created", "finalStage": finalStage, "completionSemantics": "Status Code 202 means OS installation was accepted but is not yet proven complete; Status Code 200 means the bounded OS check proved completion.", "stages": {"serverIdentity": serverIdentity, "profileDerivation": derivation, "profileAssignment": assignment, "profileDeployment": deployment, "osInstallation": osInstallation}}, separators=(",", ":"))
    aggregationReady = True
except Exception as exc:
    aggregationMessage = str(exc)
    aggregationStatusMessage = "Onboarding completed external stages but result aggregation failed."
    aggregationResultJson = json.dumps({"error": "Onboarding stage aggregation failed", "detail": aggregationMessage}, separators=(",", ":"))
